arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data for matured noninterest-bearing debt (1960-1967)
data = {
    1960: 280,
    1961: 240,
    1962: 211,
    1963: 157,
    1964: 139,
    1965: 110,
    1966: 95,
    1967: 88
}

alpha = 0.4

# Single exponential smoothing
# Initialize with first observation
years = sorted(data.keys())
values = [data[y] for y in years]

# S_0 = X_1960 (first observation)
S = [values[0]]  # S_1960

# Calculate smoothed values for each year
for t in range(1, len(values)):
    S_t = alpha * values[t] + (1 - alpha) * S[t-1]
    S.append(S_t)

print("Year | Actual | Smoothed")
print("-" * 30)
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    print(f"{year} | {values[i]} | {S[i]:.4f}")

# The forecast for 1968 is the smoothed value for 1967 (S_1967)
forecast_1968 = S[-1]
print(f"\nForecast for 1968 (rounded to 2 decimal places): {forecast_1968:.2f}")
EOF
